facts.claim: Dan Caraway 从厨房门钻出来，一边啃苹果一边又递了一个给儿子 Seth。
facts.quote: crunching into an apple, holding out another one for his son

facts.claim: Genevieve 把 Belle 领到钢琴旁，介绍金发女人 Marilyn 是自己 Oberlin 的同学。
facts.quote: “Marilyn and I were in school together,” Genevieve was telling me.

facts.claim: Belle 误问爱乐乐团雇几位钢琴家，Genevieve 插话澄清 Marilyn 是小提琴手。
Marilyn 提出让 Seth 暑假去 Institute，并说自己身为董事可以替他美言。
facts.quote: a summer at the Institute would do wonders for him

facts.claim: Marilyn 约 Genevieve 次日早上带 Seth 到 Music Room 一起练琴，随即上楼回房。
facts.quote: I want you and him to meet me tomorrow morning for a practice session

facts.claim: Genevieve 告诉 Belle，Seth 在家上学，她与 Dan 分担教学。
facts.quote: He’s homeschooled, and Dan and I divide up teaching responsibilities.

facts.claim: Rose 纠正 Genevieve：她是 Genevieve 四岁生日前六周来的，那时才三岁。
facts.quote: “It was six weeks before your fourth birthday,” said Rose.

facts.claim: Abi 低声告诉众人 Deirdre Gregory 已在大门外，并要求进来。
facts.quote: “Deirdre Gregory,” hissed Abi. “She’s outside, at the gate. And she wants in.”

relations.rel: 代笔作家与客户；见面即谈得比通常与客户更快更深
relations.quote: We were getting deep much faster than I tended to do with clients

relations.rel: Oberlin 同学、多年好友，Genevieve 请她为 Seth 伴奏
relations.quote: which is why I asked her to accompany Seth

relations.rel: 钢琴伴奏者，力主他去 Institute 学琴
relations.quote: I’m on the board, I can put in a good word

relations.rel: 雇员兼家人（Genevieve 称她“把我们这个家粘起来的人”），两人暗中有摩擦
relations.quote: If I didn’t know any better, I would say these two didn’t like each other.

relations.rel: Cheryl 在纳瓦霍保留地传教时“救了”Rose
母子；Genevieve 亲自在家教他功课
relations.quote: Genevieve’s voice rang out with the irrefutable authority of a parent.

numbers.claim: Marilyn 说 Seth 十四岁
Marilyn 说去 Institute 的还有八岁小孩
世上九成九的铂金发色是化学损伤的
numbers.quote: ninety-nine percent of platinum hair you see out in the world

numbers.claim: Margaret Fuller 死时仅四十岁
Jane Austen 四十一岁去世
Belle 自称现年四十二岁
Belle 猜 Rose 五十岁以上
numbers.quote: I guessed she had to be north of fifty

numbers.claim: Belle 推算 Rose 在 Caraway 家已三十年
numbers.quote: You’ve been with the family for thirty years then

numbers.claim: Rose 说她是 Genevieve 四岁生日前六周来的
numbers.quote: It was six weeks before your fourth birthday

numbers.claim: Genevieve 坚持自己当时四岁
Rose 坚持 Genevieve 当时三岁

numbers.quote: whisking herself up the stairs to the second floor of the house

turning_point: Rose 接到电话转告 Genevieve 后，Abi 失声惊呼——Deirdre Gregory 已到大门外并要求进来，本章在“她想要进来”处收束。
notes: Belle 即叙述者（她自报“I’m Belle”）；其姓未在本章出现。Rose 的姓 Tillohash 是叙述者“后来才知道”的追述。Genevieve 与 Rose 关于“三岁/四岁”的争执谁对谁错，文本未裁决；Belle 只判断两人互不喜欢。Deirdre Gregory 的身份与来意在本章未交代。
